notes: Bounded reconciliation of M2.5 closed candidates against the existing Brazil project claim matrix. No new claims. No duplicate claims. M2.5 artifacts remain frozen historical state. This gate does not write field_bindings.json, data/rules/**, publication metadata, or M3. CUST-002 is excluded; departure publication continues to rest on independent BR-CUST-03, which is not an adoption of that candidate.

adoptions.rationale: BR-FX-02C already states the same Art. 2º caput essence: FX-market operations may be conducted freely without a statutory value limit, subject to applicable legislation and BCB regulation. The project claim's 'statutory' qualifier is narrower than a bare 'no value limit' reading and matches the M2.5 close (supported wording is not a finding that BCB regulations contain no operational limits). CMN guidelines appear in the candidate text and are not separately named in the project rule; that omission does not make BR-FX-02C exceed the reviewed proposition. No new claim.

The reviewed candidate has two pactuation legs: authorised institutions with each other, and those institutions with their clients. BR-FX-02A keeps only the institution↔client leg ('freely agreed between authorised institutions and their clients'). The existing claim does not exceed the reviewed evidence; it is a subset. This gate does not mint a second project claim for the institution↔institution leg. No new claim.

BR-BIZ-01 already states the Art. 3º channel restriction: FX market transactions must be conducted through institutions authorised by BCB. That is the same proposition as the candidate's 'podem ser realizadas somente por meio de instituições autorizadas'. The English 'must be conducted through' does not convert the candidate into a duty to transact; it names the exclusive channel. Res. 277 appears in BR-BIZ-01 source_refs as execution context and is not added into the rule wording. No new claim.

The bounded reviewed_text covers entry e-DBV above USD 10,000 and restricts the object to papel-moeda em espécie, excluding títulos de crédito, cheques, and cheques de viagem. BR-CUST-01 already contains that entry/paper-money component ('must be declared through the e-DBV on entry and exit; requirement applies to paper money in cash'). This candidate does not establish the exit limb. BR-CUST-01's exit limb rests on independent matrix sources (Lei 14.286 Art. 14 and Receita exit guidance), not on CC-BR-CUST-001. No new claim. No silent rewrite of BR-CUST-01.

M2.5 closed this candidate as needs_evidence because the exit document-list compression cannot be supported or safely bounded from EX-BR-RECEITA-EXIT alone. It is not adopted and must not leak into claims.json. Independent project claim BR-CUST-03 already covers departure declaration plus applicable supporting evidence and is not an adoption of CC-BR-CUST-002. Publication of the departure limb, if later allowed, must stay within BR-CUST-03 and its sources, not this candidate.
